verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions retrieving call recordings or transcripts. Post-call webhooks notify a server after a call completes, the MCP server can 'inspect calls', and the testbed reads call logs, but none of these documents transcript or recording content. These are adjacent features, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can retrieve full call recordings and transcripts programmatically for every call
